# Zynexor

> Zynexor is a digital agency that designs and builds brands, websites, web apps, mobile apps and social media campaigns for growing businesses. Founded in 2023, the team of designers, developers and marketers works across Canada, the USA and Bangladesh, serving clients in Canada and the USA.

Contact: infozynexor@gmail.com · Book a free 30-minute intro call: https://calendly.com/zynexor/30min · Website: https://www.zynexor.com

## Key facts
- Services: branding, website design and development, mobile app design and development, UI/UX for SaaS and dashboards, social media marketing
- Team locations: Canada, USA, Bangladesh; works remotely with clients across Canada and the USA
- Process: discover (week 1), design (weeks 2–4), build (weeks 4–8), launch and grow (ongoing)
- Typical timelines: brand 3–6 weeks; small-business website 6–10 weeks; app MVP about 3–6 months
- Pricing: fixed price for clear scopes after a free discovery call; monthly retainers for ongoing work
- Clients own all final files, code and accounts

## Services
- [Branding](https://www.zynexor.com/services/branding): Zynexor builds brands that help small businesses, startups and professional firms in Canada and the USA look established, stand out from competitors and charge what they are worth.
- [Website design and development](https://www.zynexor.com/services/web-design): Zynexor designs and builds websites that bring in enquiries, not just compliments.
- [Mobile app design and development](https://www.zynexor.com/services/app-development): Zynexor designs and builds mobile apps that people open again tomorrow.
- [UI/UX design for SaaS and web apps](https://www.zynexor.com/services/ui-ux-design): Zynexor designs SaaS platforms, dashboards, CRMs and internal tools that are easy to learn and fast to use.
- [Social media marketing](https://www.zynexor.com/services/social-media-marketing): Zynexor plans and designs social media campaigns that keep local businesses and brands visible and bring customers through the door.

- [SocialBoost AI](https://www.zynexor.com/cases/socialboost-ai): brand and launch website for an AI social post generator
- [Style.Bd](https://www.zynexor.com/cases/style-bd): a mobile marketplace where live shopping meets verified sellers
- [Sabbir LIVE](https://www.zynexor.com/cases/sabbir-live): a creator website that turns visitors into followers

- [Immigration consultancy CRM](https://www.zynexor.com/cases/immigration-crm): leads, clients and meetings in one place
